clips.name: boot-gather
clips.caption: The whole GATHER boot animation, from a single point to the name POCKETME shrinking into the title of the home screen, then about a second of the home screen.

clips.name: home-row
clips.caption: The d-pad moves the choice along the home screen's row of tiles from BENCH to TUNDRA, resting on KESTREL and MERCATOR.

clips.name: console-start-game
clips.caption: From the home screen the d-pad walks to the KESTREL tile and starts it; KESTREL's title menu shows, then the home button opens the pause menu and BACK TO HOME returns to the home screen with KESTREL still chosen.

clips.name: console-menu
clips.caption: The home button opens the console menu over the home screen: the brightness bar goes down from five steps to two and back up, BOOT ANIM goes from FULL to SHORT, OFF and FULL again, and CLOSE shuts the menu.

clips.name: console-pause-menu
clips.caption: The home button pauses a CAMBER race: the pause menu (RESUME, brightness, BACK TO HOME) stands over the still race and the lap clock stops; the brightness goes one step down and back up, and RESUME lets the race go on.

clips.name: console-card
clips.caption: The home screen with the card slot empty says NO CARD; a card goes in and the row of tiles appears with a green CARD READY note, then the card is pulled out: NO CARD again and a red CARD REMOVED note.

stills.name: padtest-inputs
stills.caption: PADTEST showing player 1's d-pad up and right held, both sticks pushed, the right trigger part pulled, a finger on the screen and the level bubble of a tilted pad.

clips.name: padtest-inputs
clips.caption: PADTEST following player 1's pad: both sticks turn in circles, the triggers rise and fall, the buttons light one after another, a finger drags across the screen and the level bubble follows the tilt.

clips.name: padtest-players
clips.caption: Pads 2, 3 and 4 connect, each with its own PAD CONNECTED note; each holds buttons that light in its own row at the right and walks one more button along it, while player 1 holds the d-pad, shoulders, triggers, sticks and a finger on the screen.

clips.name: padtest-motion
clips.caption: With nothing held PADTEST goes ON DEMAND. Then the pad alone is tilted round in a circle while it turns: the game wakes, the level bubble and the ACCEL and GYRO numbers follow, and when the pad stops sending motion it shows NO MOTION and goes ON DEMAND again.

stills.name: bench-city
stills.caption: BENCH's CITY test at 32 buildings: driving down a four-lane street between rows of buildings, with cars in both directions.

clips.name: bench-island
clips.caption: BENCH's ISLAND test: the figure runs across the floating island past a tower and round towards a stone arch, the camera following behind.

clips.name: bench-city
clips.caption: BENCH's CITY test at 32 buildings: the eye drives down a four-lane street between rows of shops and towers, past cars going both ways, and over a zebra crossing at a junction.

clips.name: bench-tests
clips.caption: BENCH's other tests one after another at their default loads: FILL, triangles of 20, 100 and 400 pixels, VERT (corners only, nothing drawn), the SCENE tests' balls of triangles, SEND ROWS, SEND DOTS and TRI SPIN.
